caveat: Conceptual essay: 'process tracing' is named as the method but never shown, and no Caribbean classroom, teacher or student appears as data.
title: From Afro-pessimism to Afrofuturism: Epistemic educational justice through reparations - Lessons for CARICOM countries
why: Argues that curriculum grounded in Afrofuturism and reparatory justice is a route to epistemic justice in education — a pluriversal counterpart to your decolonial line, and a foil for the Santos strand in 'Substrate Matters'.
